dependencies.c4/coop-layer: Merged for real CooperationLayer.update integration verification
dependencies.c4/merge-features: Merged; reuse SensorReport, ObservedVehicle, atomic-packet validation and local-row filtering

reward_contract.per_CAV: r_i_prime = r_i + registered_weight * mean(r_j for j in observable N_i)
reward_contract.joint_layer_reward: Equal mean of per-CAV r_i_prime over the acting sample.context.members; empty-CAV steps contribute zero and no actor evidence
reward_contract.measurement_semantics: Actual measured SUMO speeds, not WM scores. This observable control-tick speed-deficit outcome does not claim to reconstruct substep-integrated SUMO global J or source-queue delay.
reward_contract.sign: Negative delay: slowing neighbours cannot increase the cooperation reward
reward_contract.neighbourhood: Other sensed vehicles, CAVs and HDVs alike; no vehicle-type field is required
reward_contract.sensing: Current own SensorReport; publisher-local rows within existing 100 m sensor range and explicitly covered lanes
reward_contract.V2V: Only explicitly selected publishers, within existing 100 m radio range, exactly t-1, nearest four with ID tie-breaks. One-hop direct sensor observations only. Remote measurement timestamps retained, never extrapolated.
reward_contract.deduplication: Self excluded; own sensing wins; then nearest publisher and publisher ID; each neighbour counted once
reward_contract.empty_neighbourhood: Team term zero; own outcome retained; empty count logged
reward_contract.missing_evidence: Missing or malformed current own outcome fails closed. Invalid/stale/future/unselected remote evidence is excluded and missing selected reports counted.
reward_contract.base_reward: Original global reward retained untouched in raw episodes and copied as base_reward for audit; never used in the new reward calculation
reward_contract.off_and_A: training_episodes returns the original episodes object and None receipt, without inspecting episode data
reward_contract.fairness: One shared weight/provenance for B and R; optional arm declaration must be exactly B and R; A cannot be opted in

configuration.track2_reward_weight: Required positive finite numeric value when enabled; no production default or tuned value
configuration.track2_reward_provenance: Required nonempty authority/registration reference for that weight
configuration.track2_reward_arms: Optional list/tuple containing exactly B and R
configuration.legacy_options: Does not activate legacy coop_reward, dense WM teaching, or WM counterfactual group-credit paths

api.settings(cfg): None when off; validated shared registration when on
api.enabled(cfg, arm): True only for explicitly enabled B/R; unconditionally false for A
api.neighbourhood_reward(own, cav_id, partne: Per-CAV own reward, neighbour mean, weighted addition, augmented reward, neighbour IDs/timestamps and evidence counts; packets use merge_features.SensorReport
api.training_episodes(cfg, arm, episodes): Returns (new cooperation-only training episodes, aggregate receipt); raw receipts never mutated; repeated shaping refused
api.layer_records(cfg, arm, episodes): Returns (CooperationLayer.update-compatible records, aggregate receipt), using existing GAE UNIT/GAMMA/LAMBDA with frozen rollout values as baseline. Historical group_advantage key carries real-outcome GAE, not WM counterfactual credit.

backend_integration.preferred_call: records, receipt = track2_reward.layer_records(cfg, arm, raw_episodes); layer.update(records, epochs=registered_epochs)
backend_integration.alternative: training_episodes provides shaped copies to a cooperation-only learner. Do not pass those copies to the base optimizer or evaluation. Do not shape twice.
backend_integration.required_step_fields: time_s, reward, sample.context.members; layer_records additionally uses existing sample.value and stochastic coop_layer sample evidence
backend_integration.direct_sensing_receipts: Uses the following step's observable rows only at time_s + CONTROL_DT_S. Explicit step.post_rows plus step.post_time_s takes precedence and is required at the terminal tick.
backend_integration.V2V_receipts: Attach step.reward_observations[cav_id] = {own: SensorReport, partner_reports: publisher-to-SensorReport mapping, partner_ids: selected IDs}. own timestamp is charged step time_s + CONTROL_DT_S; partner timestamps are exactly one control tick older.
backend_integration.PPO_eligibility: Executed-plan, deterministic, empty-group and non-layer samples excluded from layer PPO records; their measured rewards remain in the full episode return
backend_integration.receipts: Registration, source, scope, own/team/augmented sums, CAV and neighbour counts, empty/missing evidence counts, no-WM/no-global assertions, zero terminal fallback count; layer_records also reports eligible record count and advantage source

coverage: Reward formula/sign, empty neighbourhoods and speed-limit clipping

Post-action temporal alignment, terminal and missing-ego fail-closed behaviour
No mutation, no repeated shaping, equal-CAV joint aggregation
Existing GAE and PPO eligibility; actual CPU layer update changes layer parameters with frozen MAPPO byte-identical
